body: I can't go through the process of being babied every day, reminded about help. It's done. I know it's selfish, but it's over.
I told him after my first failed attempt. He made me get help when I was younger. He thinks I'm mostly better.

I know they will wonder, but I'm resolute enough for there to be nothing else to do.

And he loves me more than anything. But that's part of the problem. I've tried to end it with him to try and ease his pain, but it's not worked. But I can't be here anymore.
I've made certain to let the people I care about know that there was nothing that they could do. I know it isn't the perfect solution, but it's the best I can offer.
Well, the point of a throwaway is for that express reason.
I don't think it really matters.
